svg.title: Rueda / Toro study map
svg.desc: Orientation map with representative study locations and selected rivers and towns. Country and state outlines are geographic context, not appellation boundaries. No vineyard parcels or elevation model are implied. 1: Rueda; 2: Toro; 3: La Seca; 4: Medina del Campo; 5: Nieva; 6: San Román de Hornija; 7: Villafranca de Duero; 8: Valdefinjas; 9: Morales de Toro; 10: Valladolid; 11: Salamanca

g.title: 6 · San Román de Hornija: representative location

g.text: Light markers: study locations · dark markers: geographic context · teal: water

text.tspan: Follow the land. Compare the wines.
Open this map in the Codex for terroir, grapes, growing, cellar
choices and service. Dots locate places; they do not define a wine
